Done with the basics. Adding delete flow (hard and soft both): 
A[Teacher uploads PDF] --> B[Original saved in private bucket]
    B --> C[GPU worker reads and renders pages]
    C --> D[AIFS prepares detailed material]
    D --> E[AIFS generates script, board steps and diagrams]
    E --> F[Teacher reviews and optionally edits]
    F --> G[Approved lesson saved in bucket]
